n, m = map(int, input().split())

def compute_permutations(n, m):
    inv_list = []
    inv_list.append([1])
    for i in range(1, n):
        prev_inv = inv_list[i - 1]
        current_inv = [0] * (i * (i + 1) // 2 + 1)
        for j in range(len(current_inv)):
            total = 0
            for k in range(min(j, i), -1, -1):
                if j - k < len(prev_inv):
                    total += prev_inv[j - k]
                    total %= m
            current_inv[j] = total
        inv_list.append(current_inv)

    perms = [0] * n
    perms[0] = 0
    for i in range(1, n):
        c = (perms[i - 1] * (i + 1)) % m
        inv_arr = inv_list[i - 1]
        for j in range(len(inv_arr)):
            for k in range(j + 2, len(inv_arr)):
                min_val = min(k - j, i + 1)
                add_val = ((inv_arr[j] * inv_arr[k]) % m) * ((min_val - 1) * (2 * i - (min_val - 2)) // 2)
                c = (c + add_val) % m
        perms[i] = c
    print(perms[n - 1])

compute_permutations(n, m)
